VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Meta.Description: The Vale base frame as built: a Sapele head beam seated atop the builders upstand, a mill aluminium eaves extrusion the glaze bar cores weld to, and a lead cover flashing rebated into the timber. Three parts sharing one section frame.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Meta.SectionFrameNote: All parts are authored in one shared section frame taken from Na__Asset__Plan2D__Top. Section 0,0 is the EAVES DATUM POINT: section x=0 is the head beam inner face plane, section y=0 sits 100mm above the head beam underside (the +/-0000 seating benchmark). Section -x runs outboard to the outer upstand face at x=-125, section +y runs up. The parts assemble with no fitting.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Meta.HandAuthoredNote: Written by hand rather than generated. This is a fixed three part system, not a catalogue: a build utility scanning a folder could not know which asset fills which slot.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Meta.AssetResolutionNote: Parts name an AssetId and nothing else. The file behind an id is resolved through VghLantern__AssetRegistry__.json, which is the one place a path is written down. LibraryRoot and the per part JsonUrl were removed on 21-Aug-2026.

VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__DatumGeomet.DatumNote: The head beam outer face sits flush with the outer face of the builders upstand, so the eaves datum ring is inset one head beam width (125mm) from each stated Length/Width face. The head beam underside on the upstand top is the +/-0000 benchmark; the eaves datum level is +100mm above it. The head beam top at its inner face is 96mm above the benchmark, 4mm below the datum.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__DatumGeomet.ReferencePitchNote: The assets were exported with the weathered top faces cut for the reference roof pitch implied by the geometry below (about 19.88 degrees on the seating face). At any other pitch the top construction is re-sloped about the eaves datum origin by the geometry module; the seating benchmark, outer face, rebate construction and outer chamfer stay fixed.

VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__EavesInterf.InterfaceNote: Measured at the eaves end of every glazing bar. The aluminium core extends 42.5mm along the pitch past the eaves datum and is welded to the eaves extrusion; the decorative cap extends 170mm along the pitch past the datum; the timber trim stops short of the datum with a clean vertical plumb cut whose plane sits 18mm horizontally inboard of the datum point. The along-pitch values are constant at every roof pitch - the plan and vertical projections follow from the pitch.

VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Parts.SpecFinishNote: Rendered in the app as bare factory sealed Sapele - a dedicated wood grain material, not the lantern's chosen paint finish. The physical product can be ordered painted; the in-app model does not yet offer that toggle.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Parts.Note: Seats atop the builders upstand, outer face flush with the upstand outer face. Its underside defines the +/-0000 datum benchmark every height on the sheet is measured from.

VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Parts.SpecFinishNote: No finishes available - the raw bare extrusion, same as the glaze bar core.
VghLantern__BaseFrameSystem__Parts.Note: Authored unrotated. Rotated about the eaves datum origin to the roof pitch before sweeping. Forms a continuous ring around the lantern that the glaze bar cores seat on and weld to, and throws a drip clear of the lead flashing below.

Encircles the upstand, rebated into the head beam top and lapping 60mm down over the builders upstand finish. Its top construction follows the head beam's weathered top, so it re-slopes with the roof pitch alongside the timber.
